todays_goal: Keep futur proche in mastery mode until correct subject-to-aller mapping and infinitive use are reliable.

lessons.subject: french
lessons.previous_learning: Day 20 still showed wrong aller forms and a conjugated second verb: vous allez regarde, tu va, and elle vas.
lessons.course_context: No new grammar. Make subject + aller + infinitive automatic.
learning_objectives: Keep the second verb in the infinitive.
Produce futur proche orally and in writing at 90%+ accuracy.
lessons.why_it_matters: The near-future pattern must be automatic before longer French sentences are useful.

vocabulary.definition: the unchanged dictionary form of a verb
aller plus an infinitive to say what someone is going to do

lessons.written_instruction: Atticus: subject + correct ALLER + infinitive. Ils vont regarder. Tu vas lire. Elle va jouer.

worked_examples.title: Ils
worked_examples.explanation: Ils uses vont; jouer stays infinitive.

worked_examples.title: Elle
worked_examples.explanation: Elle uses va; lire stays infinitive.

independent_practice.prompt: Translate: They are going to watch the match.
Translate: You are going to read. (tu)
Translate: She is going to play.
Translate: We are going to eat.

exit_ticket.prompt: Say five new futur proche sentences without looking.
exit_ticket.answer: At least 4/5 correct orally and 6/6 written target.

lessons.voice_prompt: Oral first. Give one English cue at a time. Require Atticus to say subject, correct aller form, then infinitive. If wrong, identify only which part is wrong: subject/form or infinitive. Do not give the whole assigned sentence.
